summary:
**The Fourth Planet** is a NASA-inspired STEM simulation game developed using Roblox Studio. The project focuses on establishing and managing a sustainable human settlement on Mars, set in the Arcadia Planitia region. Players interact with essential outpost infrastructure, including habitat modules, a nuclear power facility, greenhouse, research laboratory, radiation shelter, communication systems, and rover hangar.

The project addresses the challenges of human survival on Mars, such as limited resources, radiation exposure, extreme environmental conditions, power requirements, and food production. Through interactive resource management, environmental simulations, and mission-based gameplay, players experience the complexities of maintaining a functional Martian settlement. One of the key missions involves deploying a rover to collect Martian rock samples.

The project is important because it transforms real-world space exploration challenges into an engaging STEM learning experience, encouraging scientific curiosity, problem-solving, and awareness of the technologies required for future human missions to Mars.
details:
The Fourth Planet is an interactive Mars settlement simulation developed in Roblox Studio using Luau scripting. The project recreates a functional Martian research base where players experience the challenges of establishing and maintaining human infrastructure on another planet.

The outpost consists of interconnected facilities, including habitat modules, a nuclear power station, a greenhouse dome, a research laboratory, a radiation shelter, communication and radar systems, and a rover hangar. Each facility represents an important component of a sustainable Mars settlement.

The gameplay combines exploration, resource management, environmental simulation, and mission-based objectives. Players can deploy rovers to explore the Martian terrain, collect rock samples, and bring them to the laboratory for scientific analysis. The environment incorporates Mars-like gravity, reddish terrain, moving dust, and simulated dust storms. Interactive systems allow players to operate equipment and engage with different outpost facilities.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
The project makes complex space science and engineering concepts accessible through interactive gameplay. It encourages STEM education, critical thinking, problem-solving, and an understanding of the challenges involved in future human missions to Mars. It also demonstrates the importance of sustainable power, food production, radiation protection, and scientific exploration.

Tools and Technologies Used:

  • Roblox Studio – Game development and environment creation.
  • Luau (Lua) – Gameplay mechanics, interaction systems, and scripting.
  • Roblox Terrain Editor – Creation of the Martian landscape.
  • Roblox Toolbox – Integration of 3D models and environmental assets.
  • Roblox ProximityPrompts and TweenService – Interactive facilities, doors, and equipment.

Creativity and Design Considerations:
The creative aspect of the project lies in combining a realistic-looking Martian research outpost with interactive simulation mechanics rather than creating a conventional exploration game. The design takes inspiration from real Mars exploration concepts and considers environmental realism, infrastructure placement, limited resources, astronaut safety, accessibility, and gameplay performance. The outpost is designed to support progressive missions, allowing players to experience increasingly complex scientific and operational challenges.

Ultimately, the project aims to turn the concept of living and working on Mars into an engaging, educational, and interactive experience.
